vo.text: This ad didn't get deleted. It never left your laptop.
Load a page, and it quietly calls out to dozens of servers — for images, scripts, and ads.
An extension checks every request's address against a filter list of known ad-server patterns.
The moment it matches, the browser cancels the request before it even opens a connection.
The server on the other end never responds — because it was never asked.
That list isn't AI. It's plain text, maintained by a handful of volunteers.
Loaded into uBlock Origin, Adblock Plus, every major blocker.
No request. No response. No ad.
